name: family-button
title: Family Button
description: A compact plus button that grows on click into a card holding an avatar, plan label and four account actions, with a round close button at the bottom.
use: Tuck account or action links behind one small corner control to save space in a dense app.
avoid: Actions need to be visible at a glance, or the menu must be keyboard reachable.
a11y: The toggle and every menu row are divs with click handlers, so nothing is focusable or announced; no roles or labels. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, a glossy dark rounded square holds one cyan circle with a black plus. Open, it becomes a tall dark card: avatar and name at top, four grey icon-and-label rows, and a round X at the bottom centre.
behaves: Clicking the plus springs the square open into the full card and fades the content in after a short delay; clicking the X rotates the plus back and shrinks it to its compact size.
customise: Menu rows are passed as children, so any links or buttons work. Size, spring and dark colours are fixed inside the file.
weight: light: A single layout morph and a fade, idle until clicked.
